provider: Hetzner Storage Box BX11 — 1 TB, €3.20/mo (price floor, no free tier)

free_tier.stated: BX11 = 1 TB at €3.20/month excl. VAT (€0.0051/hr). Ladder: BX21 5 TB €10.90, BX31 10 TB €20.80, BX41 20 TB €40.60. Zero setup fee on every tier. No free tier of any size.

egress.terms: Traffic is not the billed axis for Storage Box — pricing is capacity-only across the ladder (BX11 through BX41 differ solely in TB and hourly rate). This is the cheapest per-TB 'real storage you can serve from' in the entire corpus.

chaining: No free allowance — this is a cost benchmark, not a free source. Its role in the report is as the denominator: at €3.20/TB/mo, 20 TB cold archive is €40.60/mo, which is the number every 'free' claim in this corpus must beat.
limits_note: 10 concurrent connections is the binding limit, not bytes — a parallel-GET benchmark will be shaped by connection count: 32 parallel ranged GETs cannot be opened here, only 10. 10 snapshots. No per-file cap published.
reliability_note: RAID with checksums, explicitly NOT mirrored off-site ('The data is not mirrored onto other servers'). Snapshots can be automated. Long-standing German host; no data-loss pattern in these forums.

evidence.proved: '10 concurrent connections … BorgBackup / rsync via SSH / Restic / Rclone'; 'The data is not mirrored onto other servers'
